title: OGAP: Open Glioma Analysis Pipeline
description: A deployable, physics-grounded, safe-by-abstention, equitable-by-design brain-tumour segmentation system for low-field / LMIC MRI (BraTS-Africa, 64 mT Hyperfine Swoop), with teacher-to-student knowledge distillation, a physics-based Bloch low-field simulator, group-balanced conformal abstention, fairness-without-harm reporting, and INT8 edge deployment.
